name: K-C Maumelle Plant - Maumelle AR
type: Huggies baby wipes manufacturing plant (~400,000 sq ft)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed as 500 Murphy Dr, Maumelle, AR 72113 — K-C's Huggies baby-wipes manufacturing plant. Roster coords were ~700m NW of the building; web research yielded the street address and an address-level coordinate (34.864832,-92.393775) that lands squarely on the large white-roofed manufacturing building with extensive trailer parking. Locked center there.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed guarded truck gate at the NE corner where the access road from Murphy Dr enters. z21 imagery shows a small white guard booth astride the driveway with barrier arms across the inbound and outbound lanes.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth (~1-vehicle footprint) sitting in the pinch-point between the in/out lanes — staffed guard shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the NE building face with ~30-40 trailers backed in; 36 is an approximate count from z20 imagery — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in rows along the north perimeter, separate from the active dock apron — a drop yard, ~30-40 trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line curves along the SE edge of the property but no spur is visible entering the plant — classed not rail-served, listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved area just inside the gate before the dock apron provides truck holding/queue space.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Maumelle industrial park on the edge of the Little Rock metro; setting is small-town / edge-of-town industrial with woods around the lot — classed Rural per the tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One main manufacturing building with an integral eastern addition — a single facility, not a campus. The very large warehouse south of the lot is a separate, unrelated company.
